mapper.insert: INSERT INTO batch_history (run_id, job_name, server_name, started_at, status) VALUES (#{runId}, #{jobName}, #{serverName}, #{startedAt}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT TOP 1 status FROM batch_history WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE job_name = #{jobName} AND status <> 'RUNNING' ORDER BY started_at DESC, run_id DESC
